title: Verath — The Day After
entrance_text: You feel it — a subtle shift, like a lock being turned somewhere deep in your bones.
The System has marked you. Catalogued you. Filed you away.
Verath goes about its business around you, as if the world didn't just permanently change.

root.text: You stand in Verath's market district. The morning air smells of bread and smoke. Around you: the Adventurers' Board with posted contracts, the blacksmith's workshop, the Adventurers' Guild entrance, and the road leading to the old forest dungeon.

options.label: Head toward the dungeon. Time to see what you can do.

unknown_arrival.text:
You arrive in Verath's market district with a strange coin in your pocket and absolutely no idea what the System has done with you.

Others who went through the Rite today are comparing class designations, showing off their new skill notifications. One man nearby got 'Iron Warrior'. A woman is practically glowing — she got 'Ember Mage'.

Your status screen shows... nothing. Just 'Unclassified'. And somehow that feels exactly right.

options.label: Explore the town. Figure out what being 'Unclassified' means.

board.text:
The Adventurers' Board is covered in contracts. Most are marked 'Level 1-5 Only'. A few stand out:

• WOLF PELTS WANTED — 5g each, delivery to Maren the Tanner.
• DUNGEON SURVEY — First floor, document creature types. 30g reward.
• MISSING PERSON — Aldric Fenn, last seen entering the old forest. 100g reward.

At the bottom, someone has scrawled in charcoal: 'THE SECOND FLOOR IS DIFFERENT NOW. DON'T GO THERE.'

options.label: Note the warning about the second floor.

survey_accepted.text:
You pull the contract from the board. A small notification pulses in your vision:

OBJECTIVE ADDED: Survey Dungeon Floor 1. Document creature types for the Adventurers' Guild. Reward: 30 gold.

guild.text:
The Adventurers' Guild is a low-ceilinged hall that smells of leather and pine resin. A woman behind the counter with close-cropped silver hair and a Guild insignia on her shoulder looks up.

'New face. Fresh from your Rite, I'd wager.' She glances at your status — that slight unfocusing of the eyes that means she's reading your System profile. Her eyebrow goes up. Just a fraction.

'Hm. You should probably start with the dungeon's first floor. Everyone does.'

options.label: Ask about the second floor specifically.

guild_dungeon_info.text:
'Standard dungeon. Three registered floors. First floor is Rank F — goblins, slimes, the occasional oversized rat. Good for new classifications.' She pauses. 'Second floor has been... irregular lately. We've had two survey teams not come back. Third floor is sealed until the Ranking Committee says otherwise.

Stick to the first floor until your rank improves.'

guild_second_floor.text:
The guildmaster's expression sharpens. She leans forward.

'Where did you hear about the second floor?' She doesn't wait for an answer. 'The creatures there — they're not matching their registered ranks. A Rank F dungeon floor is producing Rank C creatures. The System's data doesn't account for it. We don't know why.

Don't go there. Not yet.'

options.label: Promise to stay on the first floor.

blacksmith.text:
The blacksmith is a barrel-chested man named Torven who looks at you the way craftsmen look at everything — as a problem to be assessed and solved.

'New adventurer, eh. Got some basics in stock. Nothing fancy, but it'll keep you alive on the first floor.'

shop.text:
Available for purchase:
• Iron Sword — 50 gold (STR +2)
• Leather Armor — 40 gold (VIT +2, AGI +1, END +1)
• Health Potion — 25 gold
• Mana Potion — 30 gold

(Shop functionality coming soon — use gold to prepare for the dungeon.)
